about: 재고1 마무리 묶음9 월별채권증감내역 · 월별채무증감내역 (원본 E040713 · E040714 실측) — 조건 [기준일자] 년/월 ~ 년/월(기본 금월), 거래처마다 다섯 줄(매출 · 수금 · 기타할인등차액 · 잔액 · 미회수액) + 끝 [누계] 다섯 줄, 채권/채무 알약 없음. QA 거래처에 판매 입력 화면으로 660 · 수금 200 · 구매 1,100 을 넣고 매출 660 · 수금 200 · 잔액 460 · 매입 1,100 을 본다. 미회수액 규칙은 묶음 36(칸은 비어 있음). 끝에 만든 것을 지운다.

shots.name: 준비 — QA 거래처 · 품목, 구매 10 × 100 (채무 1,100)
판매입력 화면으로 판매 (2 × 300 = 660) 저장
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const s = (await (await fetch('/api/sales', { headers: H })).json()).sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id)[0]; const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('b9')); (S.sales = S.sales || []).push({ id: s.id, total: s.totalAmount }); sessionStorage.setItem('b9', JSON.stringify(S)); return s.totalAmount })()

shots.name: 수금 200 (정산 API — 수금 입력 화면은 길어 API)
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const today = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('b9')); const st = await fetch('/api/settlements', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'RECEIPT', partnerId: S.partnerId, amount: 200, method: 'CASH', settleDate: today, note: 'QA재고1 월별' }) }); const sj = await st.json(); S.settleId = sj.id; sessionStorage.setItem('b9', JSON.stringify(S)); return st.status })()

shots.name: 월별채권증감내역 — 조건 기준일자 기간 · 알약 없음, 다섯 줄, [누계]
steps: js:window.__tr = () => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')]; const i = t.findIndex((r) => r.cells[0] && r.cells[0].innerText.trim() === 'QAB9P'); return t.slice(i, i + 5) }; window.__lab = () => window.__tr().map((r, k) => r.cells[k ? 0 : 2].innerText.trim()).join('|'); window.__col = () => { const ym = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4).toISOString().slice(0, 7).replace('-', '/'); return [...document.querySelectorAll('thead th')].findIndex((h) => h.innerText.trim() === ym) }; window.__v = (k) => { const r = window.__tr()[k]; const v = r.cells[window.__col() - (k ? 2 : 0)].innerText.replace(/,/g, '').trim(); return v === '' ? 0 : Number(v) }; true

shots.name: 월별채무증감내역 — 매입 1,100 · 지급 줄
steps: js:window.__tr = () => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')]; const i = t.findIndex((r) => r.cells[0] && r.cells[0].innerText.trim() === 'QAB9P'); return t.slice(i, i + 5) }; window.__lab = () => window.__tr().map((r, k) => r.cells[k ? 0 : 2].innerText.trim()).join('|'); window.__col = () => { const ym = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4).toISOString().slice(0, 7).replace('-', '/'); return [...document.querySelectorAll('thead th')].findIndex((h) => h.innerText.trim() === ym) }; window.__v = (k) => { const r = window.__tr()[k]; const v = r.cells[window.__col() - (k ? 2 : 0)].innerText.replace(/,/g, '').trim(); return v === '' ? 0 : Number(v) }; true

finally: js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const g = async (u) => (await fetch(u, { headers: H })).json(); const today = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const S = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('b9') || '{}'); const del = (u) => fetch(u, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); if (S.settleId) await del('/api/settlements/' + S.settleId); for (const s of S.sales || []) await del('/api/sales/' + s.id); if (S.purchaseId) await del('/api/purchases/' + S.purchaseId); if (S.partnerId) await del('/api/partners/' + S.partnerId); if (S.itemId) await del('/api/items/' + S.itemId); sessionStorage.removeItem('b9'); return true })()
